entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. Just get me a person. This is unbelievable.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this helmet I bought. Your whole process is a joke. I just want my money back, now.

I can certainly look into that for you. I understand you're frustrated. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A preference? The color is hideous! It looks nothing like what I saw online. I haven't even taken it out, the box is unopened. I'm not putting that thing on my head.
I see. I'm sorry to hear the color wasn't what you expected. The most important thing is that you have a helmet you'll actually wear for your safety. Let me just pull up your account information.
Don't give me the runaround! I know how this works. You're going to tell me I'm a few days too late and I'm stuck with it. I want to speak to your manager right now. This is ridiculous!
Sir, I can absolutely handle this for you. I see here that your order was delivered 12 days ago. I've just checked our policy, and for this helmet, we have a 10-day return window.
What? Ninety days? Are you sure? Don't play games with me.
Yes, I'm sure. Since the box is unopened and you're well within that timeframe, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. I will email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Oh. So... you're just going to take it back? No problem?
That's correct. No problem at all. Your satisfaction and safety are our priorities. Once we receive the helmet, you can expect the refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Huh. Well... okay then. Fine. Send me the label.
The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
